page.notes: Printed in three columns; the 1st and 2nd columns end in the middle of the entries. Letters and numerals in some entries are partly obscured by a damaged fold and by the marks of a paper clip at the top margin; the words "dei gratia liberrima", "dei misericordia" (two entries) and "deo patri nō" are read as printed.
